subject: LEAP-SECOND directive
notes: Rule: 'If the LEAP-SECOND directive is not specified, a LEAP-SECOND directive with the OFF phrase is implied before the first compilation unit in the compilation group.' (cite.py --check 7.3.17.4 OK). Process() starts on=false and returns it when no directive is seen (and (text,false) when the text has no '>>'). Probe a_implied.cob (no directive): SFFT('hhmmss','235960')=0, TEST-FORMATTED-DATETIME('hhmmss','120060')=5, FORMATTED-TIME('hhmmss',86400)=spaces - the OFF bounds. Last directive before the first unit wins (c_lastwins ON then OFF -> OFF; e_offon OFF then 'ON *> on' -> ON). l1_fdt_argument3_time_form writes no directive and asserts 86400 is CAUGHT, derived from §15.5.5 / §7.3.17.4 GR5 under the implied OFF. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the §7.3 directive facility is absent in 1985; the 2002 edge is DERIVED per docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row 7.21 - Annex E itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and does not list LEAP-SECOND, so it predates 2023). The time-form / formatted-time consumers the rule bounds are COBOL-2014 intrinsics (§15.3). || code sites: LeapSecondDirectiveProcessor.Process holds the directive state and src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Pipeline/Frontend.cs calls it
